subject: sg
title: SG.------FUND.DYM.
description: Diagram in WAC-8, paired with v1-p210-1. (C)SG (source initiation, the (c) prefix marking the conceptual reading) is crossed with FUND-DYM (fundamental dynamics): the question is what source initiation as a concept means in relation to a culture's fundamental dynamics. Besides the main line to FUND-DYM, two branches leave the subject. COP-P carries PHY-U-C (physical universe context) → TR-DIFF → VT-PLT (vibrational platform). PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) carries INDIV-TD (individual tendencies) → POL-DY (political dynamics), which branches to TM (terminology—or terms of a definition) and to PHY-U-P (physical universe particular) → SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics).
